# Include the seller's registered name

## Project interpretation
A seller legal identifier does not substitute for the seller name. The legal
entity block needs the name by which the seller is identified in the transaction.

## Common causes
- Only identifier fields were selected from the supplier master record.
- A trading name was mapped elsewhere while the legal name was left empty.
- Whitespace-only names were removed during serialization.

## Safe fix
Populate the seller registration name from verified party data and keep the
identifier as a separate field. Confirm that the chosen name is appropriate for
the transaction; validation cannot establish legal identity. Revalidate the
complete document.

## Failing fragment
```xml
<cac:PartyLegalEntity>
  <cbc:CompanyID schemeID="0151">47555222000</cbc:CompanyID>
</cac:PartyLegalEntity>
```

## Corrected fragment
```xml
<cac:PartyLegalEntity>
  <cbc:RegistrationName>Example AU Supplier Pty Ltd</cbc:RegistrationName>
  <cbc:CompanyID schemeID="0151">47555222000</cbc:CompanyID>
</cac:PartyLegalEntity>
```
